title: Terminally-Ill Genius Dark Knight
altTitles: 余命わずかの天才暗黒騎士
身患绝症的天才暗黑骑士
Kỵ Sĩ Bóng Đêm Thiên Tài Gần Kề Cái Chết
description: Yoo Chan, a young man diagnosed with a terminal illness, has spent his life playing the notoriously difficult fantasy RPG Inner Lunatic. One day, the game becomes reality, and Yoo Chan finds himself inside the body of Nox von Reinharber, the worst villain of the game's first act. With a limited lifespan and knowledge of the game's events, he must survive the deadly world, overcome his predetermined fate, and find a way to reach the end of the story.
author: Jung SeonYul
